### hd-fn-rm-after
f() {
cat <<EOF
hi
EOF
rm -rf /tmp/x
}
f
### hd-fn-stderr-dash-quoted
f() {
	cat >&2 <<-'EOF'
		warning
	EOF
	rm -rf /tmp/x
}
f
### hd-fn-then-second-fn
f() {
cat <<EOF
hi
EOF
}
g() { rm -rf /tmp/x; }
f
g
### hd-toplevel-then-fn-def
cat <<EOF
hi
EOF
g() { rm -rf /tmp/x; }
g
### hd-in-if
if true; then
cat <<EOF
hi
EOF
fi
rm -rf /tmp/x
### hd-pipe-then-rm
cat <<EOF | tee /etc/motd
hi
EOF
rm -rf /tmp/x
### hd-toplevel-two-cmds-after
cat <<EOF
hi
EOF
rm -rf /tmp/x
rm -rf /tmp/y
